best_fixed_rule.rule: most on-time per episode; tie to fewer bytes; tie to the protocol's row order

bootstrap_audit.rule: one call per (layer, axis, baseline); every CI in the report is sliced from it

hindsight_envelope.definition: per-stream maximum of the seven budgeted competitors on on-time targets, ties broken towards fewer bytes; an experience bound, not a deployable strategy

sender_visible_features.definition: streams where exactly one competitor is the per-stream winner, grouped by that winner; means of sender-visible quantities only, descriptive, no model fitted
